title: Common Fund Data Ecosystem at Festival of Genomics Boston 2025!
bodyHtml:
Are you headed to the Festival of Genomics Boston June 24-25th, 2025? Learn about the Common Fund Data Ecosystem and the Knowledge Center.

Head over to booth 60B to talk to the Knowledge Center team about a demonstration, connections made between Data Coordinating Centers, and connect with an NIH Program Officer to learn about potential funding opportunities!

On Wednesday, June 25th from 11:30 AM - 1 PM ET, we will have a scientific presentation as part of the Genome Dome! Hear from Noël Burtt and Jason Flannick from the Knowledge Center, along with Ari Khan from A2CPS and the CWIC.
summary: Are you headed to the Festival of Genomics Boston June 24-25th, 2025? Learn about the Common Fund Data Ecosystem and the Knowledge Center.
